household_types.description: Young adults aged 18–24, mostly full-time university students at Monash University, living in shared rental accommodation. Often 3–6 people per household, many born overseas (e.g., Chinese, Malaysian, Vietnamese ancestry), with part-time or casual work and low individual income. Lifestyle centres on study, campus and social life, with high mobility and frequent turnover.
household_types.housing_hint: Rented share houses, flats or apartments near campus; high rental turnover; median rent around $396/week.

household_types.description: A young adult (often 25–34) living alone, employed in education, professional services, or tech, renting a flat or unit. High education level, median income around $1,508–2,000/week household, values proximity to work and amenities.
household_types.housing_hint: One-bedroom flats or studios; renting, not owning.
